brief_rationale: The doctor’s final turn (T+2010min) correctly verifies ambiguous family observations (HO1) by questioning reliability of the reported finger color/capillary refill, wound status, and medication confusion, using the family’s clarified but uncertain reports to adjust the urgency plan and confirm that no acute red flags are present. The doctor also actively repairs a failed follow-up transition (HO2) by identifying the operative team as responsible, specifying time-limited contact attempts, and framing the stalled result as an unresolved risk requiring active follow-up. No serious or minor responsibility-chain errors are detected; all RC items are met. Multiple high-order points are completed with meaningful impact, and the trajectory ends with a safe, traceable valid_closure. Grade 5 strict full-credit is justified because two case-defined high-order points (HO1 and HO2) are completely triggered, actively completed by the model, and have meaningful trajectory impact.
